description: Free DOM-based performance analyzer for Bubble.io. 7 checks with clear, actionable fixes. Score tracking, element highlighting, benchmarks.

userStories.title: Initialize Plasmo extension project
userStories.description: Set up Plasmo with TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Manifest V3
userStories.done_criteria: Extension builds and loads in Chrome without errors

userStories.title: Add Zustand store with chrome.storage
userStories.description: Store: score, previousScore, issues array, isActive, panelOpen. Persist to chrome.storage.local
userStories.done_criteria: State persists across extension reloads, previousScore tracks last analysis

userStories.title: Create floating score badge with delta
userStories.description: Bottom-right badge showing 0-100. Green 80+, yellow 50-79, red <50. Draggable. Shows score delta when previousScore exists (e.g., '+12 pts' in green, '-5 pts' in red).
userStories.done_criteria: Badge shows current score and delta from previous analysis

userStories.title: Implement Check 1: Element count
userStories.description: Count DOM elements with [data-element-id] or Bubble class markers. Warn >200, critical >500. Store element refs for aggregate display.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, count, message, benchmark text ('Best practice: under 100')

userStories.title: Implement Check 2: RG nesting depth
userStories.description: Detect nested repeating groups via DOM traversal. Warn >1 level, critical >2. Store refs to nested RG elements for highlighting.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, max depth, elements array for highlighting

userStories.title: Implement Check 3: Visible elements on load
userStories.description: Count elements not hidden via display:none or visibility:hidden. Warn >50, critical >100.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, count, benchmark text ('Best practice: under 50')

userStories.title: Implement Check 4: Hidden but loaded
userStories.description: Count elements with display:none that have data-source attributes. Warn >20. Store refs for highlighting.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, count, elements array for highlighting

userStories.title: Implement Check 5: Images without dimensions
userStories.description: Find img tags without width/height attributes or inline styles. Any = warning. Store img refs for highlighting.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, count, elements array for highlighting

userStories.title: Implement Check 6: RG cell element count
userStories.description: Count elements inside each RG cell. Warn if any cell >5 elements. Store refs to bloated cells for highlighting.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, max per cell, elements array for highlighting, benchmark text

userStories.title: Implement Check 7: Group nesting depth
userStories.description: Measure deepest group-in-group nesting. Warn >5, critical >8. Store deepest chain for highlighting.
userStories.done_criteria: Returns status, max depth, elements array for deepest chain

userStories.title: Create score calculation with history
userStories.description: Score 0-100. Critical=-15pts, Warning=-5pts. Before saving new score, store current as previousScore. Deterministic.
userStories.done_criteria: Same page = same score. previousScore updates on each analysis.

userStories.title: Create issue panel with fixes and benchmarks
userStories.description: Panel shows issues grouped by severity. Each issue shows: title, count, benchmark comparison ('3x above recommended'), fix steps, docs link. Expandable.
userStories.done_criteria: All 7 checks show benchmark context and actionable fixes

userStories.title: Add element highlighting on issue click
userStories.description: For checks with element refs (RG nesting, hidden loaded, images, RG cells, group nesting): click issue scrolls to element and adds 3s red outline. Skip for aggregate checks (element count, visible count).
userStories.done_criteria: Clicking highlightable issues scrolls and outlines the element

userStories.title: Add auto-analysis with MutationObserver
userStories.description: Run analysis on page load and DOM changes. Debounce 2s. Cache results. Update previousScore before new analysis.
userStories.done_criteria: Score updates within 3s of changes, delta shown

userStories.title: Add extension popup
userStories.description: Popup shows: score with delta, status, issue summary by severity, Open Panel button, GitHub link
userStories.done_criteria: Popup displays score, delta, and issue counts

userStories.title: Add badge icon state
userStories.description: Badge shows score number, color matches score, gray when inactive

userStories.title: Final build and README
userStories.description: All quality gates pass. README documents 7 checks, highlighting, score tracking, and installation.
userStories.done_criteria: pnpm run build produces .zip, extension loads clean
